segments.tr: La justification avancée derrière le décret revisite l'affirmation de longue date selon laquelle les vaccins, et le vaccin ROR en particulier, sont liés à l'autisme.

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: Cette théorie remonte à une seule étude de 1998 publiée dans *The Lancet*, qui a ensuite été rétractée après que des enquêteurs ont découvert que la recherche était basée sur des données falsifiées et des conflits d'intérêts financiers non divulgués.

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: Son auteur principal a ensuite perdu sa licence médicale.

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: Au cours des années qui ont suivi, cette affirmation a été examinée à plusieurs reprises.

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: Des études à grande échelle portant sur des millions d'enfants — y compris une étude de cohorte danoise largement citée suivant plus de 650 000 enfants — n'ont trouvé aucun lien de cause à effet entre le vaccin ROR et l'autisme.

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: Les CDC, l'Organisation mondiale de la santé, l'Académie américaine de pédiatrie et les autorités sanitaires équivalentes en Europe et en Asie affirment toutes que les preuves actuelles ne soutiennent pas un lien entre la vaccination infantile et l'autisme.

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: Les responsables de la santé publique soulignent que les diagnostics d'autisme ont augmenté au cours des dernières décennies principalement en raison de critères de diagnostic plus larges, d'une sensibilisation accrue et d'un dépistage élargi — et non d'un changement dans les ingrédients ou les calendriers des vaccins.

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## Opposition des groupes médicaux

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: Les organisations pédiatriques et de santé publique ont agi rapidement pour critiquer le décret.

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: Des groupes tels que l'Académie américaine de pédiatrie ont historiquement averti que le fait de retarder ou de diviser les vaccins combinés comme le ROR augmente le nombre de visites en clinique nécessaires pour obtenir une protection complète, ce qui, selon la recherche, réduit les taux d'achèvement globaux — en particulier chez les familles à faible revenu ayant moins d'accès aux soins de santé réguliers.

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: Une lacune dans la couverture, préviennent-ils, augmente le risque d'épidémies de maladies telles que la rougeole, qui est hautement contagieuse et peut être grave ou mortelle chez les jeunes enfants.

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: Les experts en politique vaccinale ont également exprimé leur inquiétude quant au fait que la réouverture formelle de la question de l'autisme au niveau fédéral confère une légitimité injustifiée à une affirmation qui a été étudiée de manière approfondie et non étayée par des données probantes, ce qui pourrait saper la confiance du public dans un calendrier crédité d'avoir fortement réduit la mortalité infantile due à des maladies évitables au cours du siècle dernier.

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## Obstacles juridiques et politiques à venir

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: Les spécialistes du droit de la santé affirment que le décret devra probablement faire face à des contestations judiciaires sur plusieurs fronts, notamment des questions sur la capacité du pouvoir exécutif à ordonner unilatéralement des modifications aux calendriers de vaccination qui sont généralement fixés par le Comité consultatif sur les pratiques de vaccination des CDC (ACIP) à la suite d'un examen scientifique indépendant, ainsi que sur les exigences procédurales en vertu de la loi fédérale sur l'élaboration des règles.

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: Plusieurs procureurs généraux d'État et associations médicales ont indiqué qu'ils pourraient demander des injonctions pour bloquer la mise en œuvre pendant que le processus d'examen se déroule.

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: Le décret arrive dans un contexte d'examen minutieux de la politique vaccinale sous l'administration actuelle, comprenant des changements de personnel dans les agences de santé fédérales et des efforts antérieurs pour réviser les directives d'immunisation.

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: Étant donné que tout changement officiel au calendrier recommandé nécessite généralement l'élaboration de règles par l'agence, des périodes de commentaires publics et l'examen par un comité d'experts, les analystes de la politique de santé préviennent que le déploiement pratique — s'il survit aux contestations judiciaires — pourrait prendre des mois, voire plus.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: HHS and the CDC are expected to issue further guidance in the coming weeks outlining how the review will proceed and whether any interim recommendations will be issued to pediatricians.
segments.tr: Le HHS et les CDC devraient publier de nouvelles directives dans les semaines à venir décrivant comment l'examen se déroulera et si des recommandations provisoires seront émises pour les pédiatres.

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: Il est conseillé aux parents que, pour l'instant, le calendrier de vaccination recommandé par les CDC reste en vigueur, et les familles ayant des questions sur le moment de la vaccination devraient consulter le pédiutre de leur enfant plutôt que de modifier leurs plans de vaccination en se basant uniquement sur le décret présidentiel.

segments.src: This is a developing story and will be updated as federal agencies release further details.
segments.tr: C'est une histoire en développement et elle sera mise à jour à mesure que les agences fédérales publieront plus de détails.

pt.title: Três Doses em Vez de Uma: Por Dentro da Ordem de Trump para Reescrever o Calendário de Vacinação Infantil

segments.src: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal health agencies to overhaul the childhood immunization schedule, calling for pediatric vaccines to be spaced further apart and for the combined measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) shot to be split into three separate doses given on different visits.
segments.tr: O presidente Donald Trump assinou uma ordem executiva determinando que as agências federais de saúde reformulem o calendário de imunização infantil, exigindo que as vacinas pediátricas sejam espaçadas e que a vacina combinada tríplice viral (sarampo, caxumba e rubéola - MMR) seja dividida em três doses separadas aplicadas em visitas diferentes.

segments.src: The order has reignited a decades-old debate over vaccine safety and autism, drawn swift criticism from major medical organizations, and is widely expected to trigger legal action before it can take effect.
segments.tr: A ordem reavivou um debate de décadas sobre a segurança das vacinas e o autismo, gerou críticas rápidas de grandes organizações médicas e deve amplamente desencadear ações judiciais antes de entrar em vigor.

segments.src: ## What the Order Directs
segments.tr: ## O que a Ordem Determina

segments.src: According to summaries of the order, the administration has instructed the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to review the current recommended schedule and develop guidance that would:
segments.tr: De acordo com os resumos da ordem, a administração instruiu o Departamento de Saúde e Serviços Humanos (HHS) e os Centros de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (CDC) a revisarem o calendário recomendado atual e desenvolverem diretrizes que:

segments.src: - Increase the interval between certain childhood vaccinations rather than administering several shots in a single visit.
segments.tr: - Aumentem o intervalo entre certas vacinas infantilis em vez de administrar várias injeções em uma única visita.

segments.src: - Break the combined MMR vaccine into three individual doses — measles, mumps, and rubella — given separately over time instead of as one combination shot.
segments.tr: - Dividam a vacina combinada MMR em três doses individuais — sarampo, caxumba e rubéola — administradas separadamente ao longo do tempo, em vez de uma única injeção combinada.

segments.src: - Direct federal agencies to study and report further on any possible link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.
segments.tr: - Direcionem as agências federais para estudar e relatar mais sobre qualquer possível ligação entre vacinas e o transtorno do espectro autista.

segments.src: The order does not immediately ban the current combination vaccine outright, but it directs agencies to draft new recommendations and consider regulatory or guidance changes that could reshape how pediatricians and public clinics administer shots nationwide.
segments.tr: A ordem não proíbe imediatamente a vacina combinada atual por completo, mas direciona as agências a redigirem novas recomendações e considerarem mudanças regulatórias ou de diretrizes que possam remodelar a forma como pediatras e clínicas públicas aplicam injeções em todo o país.

segments.src: ## The Autism Claim, and What the Science Actually Shows
segments.tr: ## A Alegação sobre o Autismo e o que a Ciência Realmente Mostra

segments.src: The stated rationale behind the order revisits the long-running claim that vaccines, and the MMR shot in particular, are linked to autism.
segments.tr: A justificativa declarada por trás da ordem revisita a alegação de longa data de que as vacinas, e a vacina MMR em particular, estão ligadas ao autismo.

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: Essa teoria remonta a um único estudo de 1998 publicado na *The Lancet*, que foi posteriormente retratado depois que os investigadores descobriram que a pesquisa se baseava em dados falsificados e conflitos de interesse financeiros não divulgados.

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: Seu autor principal perdeu subsequentemente sua licença médica.

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: Nos anos seguintes, a alegação foi examinada repetidamente.

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: Estudos em larga escala envolvendo milhões de crianças — incluindo um estudo de coorte dinamarquês amplamente citado que acompanhou mais de 650.000 crianças — não encontraram nenhuma ligação causal entre a vacina MMR e o autismo.

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: O CDC, a Organização Mundial da Saúde, a Academia Americana de Pediatria e autoridades de saúde equivalentes na Europa e na Ásia afirmam que as evidências atuais não apoiam uma conexão entre a vacinação infantil e o autismo.

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: Funcionários de saúde pública observam que os diagnósticos de autismo aumentaram nas últimas décadas principalmente devido a critérios de diagnóstico mais amplos, maior conscientização e triagem expandida — e não a uma mudança nos ingredientes ou calendários das vacinas.

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## Reação de Grupos Médicos

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: Organizações pediátricas e de saúde pública agiram rapidamente para criticar a ordem.

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: Grupos como a Academia Americana de Pediatria historicamente alertam que atrasar ou dividir vacinas combinadas como a MMR aumenta o número de visitas à clínica necessárias para alcançar proteção completa, o que pesquisas sugerem reduzir as taxas gerais de conclusão — particularmente entre famílias de baixa renda com menos acesso a cuidados de saúde regulares.

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: Uma lacuna na cobertura, alertam eles, aumenta o risco de surtos de doenças como o sarampo, que é altamente contagioso e pode ser grave ou fatal em crianças pequenas.

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: Especialistas em políticas de vacinação também levantaram preocupações de que reabrir formalmente a questão do autismo a nível federal confere legitimidade indevida a uma alegação que foi extensivamente estudada e não apoiada por evidências, potencialmente minando a confiança pública em um calendário creditado por reduzir drasticamente a mortalidade infantil por doenças evitáveis ao longo do último século.

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## Obstáculos Legais e Políticos à Frente

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: Especialistas em direito sanitário dizem que a ordem provavelmente enfrentará desafios judiciais em várias frentes, incluindo questões sobre se o poder executivo pode direcionar unilateralmente mudanças nos calendários de vacinas que normalmente são estabelecidos por meio do Comitê Consultivo de Práticas de Imunização (ACIP) do CDC após revisão científica independente, bem como requisitos procedimentais sob a lei de regulamentação federal.

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: Vários procuradores-gerais estaduais e associações médicas sinalizaram que podem buscar liminares para bloquear a implementação enquanto o processo de revisão se desenrola.

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: A ordem chega em meio a um escrutínio mais amplo da política de vacinas sob a administração atual, incluindo mudanças de pessoal em agências federais de saúde e esforços anteriores para revisitar as diretrizes de imunização.

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: Como qualquer mudança formal no calendário recomendado normalmente exige a regulamentação da agência, períodos de consulta pública e revisão por comitês de especialistas, analistas de políticas de saúde alertam que a implementação prática — se sobreviver aos desafios legais — pode levar meses ou mais.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: HHS and the CDC are expected to issue further guidance in the coming weeks outlining how the review will proceed and whether any interim recommendations will be issued to pediatricians.
segments.tr: Espera-se que o HHS e o CDC emitam mais orientações nas próximas semanas delineando como a revisão prosseguirá e se alguma recomendação provisória será emitida para os pediatras.

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: Os pais são avisados de que, a partir de agora, o calendário de imunização existente recomendado pelo CDC permanece em vigor, e as famílias com dúvidas sobre o momento da vacinação devem consultar o pediatra de seus filhos em vez de alterar os planos de imunização com base apenas na ordem executiva.

segments.src: This is a developing story and will be updated as federal agencies release further details.
segments.tr: Esta é uma história em desenvolvimento e será atualizada à medida que as agências federais divulgarem mais detalhes.

in.title: Tiga Suntikan, Bukan Satu: Di Dalam Perintah Trump untuk Menulis Ulang Jadwal Vaksin Anak

segments.src: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal health agencies to overhaul the childhood immunization schedule, calling for pediatric vaccines to be spaced further apart and for the combined measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) shot to be split into three separate doses given on different visits.
segments.tr: Presiden Donald Trump telah menandatangani perintah eksekutif yang mengarahkan lembaga-lembaga kesehatan federal untuk merombak jadwal imunisasi anak, menyerukan agar vaksin anak diberi jarak lebih jauh dan agar suntikan kombinasi campak-gondongan-rubella (MMR) dipisah menjadi tiga dosis terpisah yang diberikan pada kunjungan berbeda.

segments.src: The order has reignited a decades-old debate over vaccine safety and autism, drawn swift criticism from major medical organizations, and is widely expected to trigger legal action before it can take effect.
segments.tr: Perintah tersebut telah membakar kembali perdebatan puluhan tahun tentang keamanan vaksin dan autisme, memicu kritik cepat dari organisasi medis utama, dan diperkirakan secara luas akan memicu tindakan hukum sebelum dapat mulai berlaku.

segments.src: ## What the Order Directs
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Diperintahkan dalam Perintah Tersebut

segments.src: According to summaries of the order, the administration has instructed the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to review the current recommended schedule and develop guidance that would:
segments.tr: Menurut ringkasan perintah tersebut, pemerintah telah menginstruksikan Departemen Kesehatan dan Layanan Masyarakat (HHS) dan Pusat Pengendalian dan Pencegahan Penyakit (CDC) untuk meninjau jadwal rekomendasi saat ini dan mengembangkan panduan yang akan:

segments.src: - Increase the interval between certain childhood vaccinations rather than administering several shots in a single visit.
segments.tr: - Meningkatkan interval antara vaksinasi anak tertentu daripada memberikan beberapa suntikan sekaligus dalam satu kunjungan.

segments.src: - Break the combined MMR vaccine into three individual doses — measles, mumps, and rubella — given separately over time instead of as one combination shot.
segments.tr: - Memecah vaksin MMR kombinasi menjadi tiga dosis individu — campak, gondongan, dan rubella — yang diberikan secara terpisah seiring waktu, bukan sebagai satu suntikan kombinasi.

segments.src: - Direct federal agencies to study and report further on any possible link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.
segments.tr: - Mengarahkan lembaga federal untuk mempelajari dan melaporkan lebih lanjut tentang kemungkinan hubungan apa pun antara vaksin dan gangguan spektrum autisme.

segments.src: The order does not immediately ban the current combination vaccine outright, but it directs agencies to draft new recommendations and consider regulatory or guidance changes that could reshape how pediatricians and public clinics administer shots nationwide.
segments.tr: Perintah tersebut tidak serta-merta melarang vaksin kombinasi saat ini secara langsung, namun mengarahkan lembaga-lembaga untuk menyusun rekomendasi baru dan mempertimbangkan perubahan regulasi atau panduan yang dapat mengubah cara dokter anak dan klinik umum memberikan suntikan di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: ## The Autism Claim, and What the Science Actually Shows
segments.tr: ## Klaim Autisme, dan Apa yang Sebenarnya Ditunjukkan oleh Sains

segments.src: The stated rationale behind the order revisits the long-running claim that vaccines, and the MMR shot in particular, are linked to autism.
segments.tr: Alasan yang dinyatakan di balik perintah tersebut meninjau kembali klaim lama bahwa vaksin, dan suntikan MMR pada khususnya, berkaitan dengan autisme.

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: Teori itu berasal dari sebuah studi tunggal tahun 1998 yang diterbitkan di *The Lancet*, yang kemudian ditarik setelah para peneliti menemukan bahwa penelitian tersebut didasarkan pada data yang dipalsukan dan konflik kepentingan keuangan yang tidak diungkapkan.

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: Penulis utamanya kemudian kehilangan lisensi medisnya.

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: Dalam tahun-tahun sejak itu, klaim tersebut telah diperiksa berulang kali.

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: Studi berskala besar yang melibatkan jutaan anak — termasuk studi kohort Denmark yang banyak dikutip yang mengikuti lebih dari 650.000 anak — tidak menemukan hubungan sebab akibat antara vaksin MMR dan autisme.

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: CDC, Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia (WHO), American Academy of Pediatrics, dan otoritas kesehatan setara di Eropa dan Asia semuanya menyatakan bahwa bukti saat ini tidak mendukung hubungan antara vaksinasi anak dan autisme.

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: Pejabat kesehatan masyarakat mencatat bahwa diagnosis autisme telah meningkat selama beberapa dekade terakhir sebagian besar karena kriteria diagnosis yang lebih luas, peningkatan kesadaran, dan skrining yang diperluas — bukan perubahan dalam bahan atau jadwal vaksin.

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## Penolakan dari Kelompok Medis

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: Organisasi anak dan kesehatan masyarakat bergerak cepat untuk mengkritik perintah tersebut.

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: Kelompok-kelompok termasuk American Academy of Pediatrics secara historis telah memperingatkan bahwa menunda atau memisah vaksin kombinasi seperti MMR meningkatkan jumlah kunjungan klinik yang diperlukan untuk mencapai perlindungan penuh, yang menurut penelitian menurunkan tingkat penyelesaian secara keseluruhan — terutama di antara keluarga berpenghasilan lebih rendah dengan akses yang lebih sedikit ke layanan kesehatan rutin.

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: Celah dalam cakupan, mereka memperingatkan, meningkatkan risiko wabah penyakit seperti campak, yang sangat menular dan bisa berakibat serius atau fatal pada anak-anak.

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: Pakar kebijakan vaksin juga menyoroti kekhawatiran bahwa membuka kembali pertanyaan autisme secara resmi di tingkat federal memberikan legitimasi yang tidak semestinya pada klaim yang telah dipelajari secara ekstensif dan tidak didukung oleh bukti, yang berpotensi merusak kepercayaan publik terhadap jadwal yang berjasa menurunkan mortalitas anak akibat penyakit yang dapat dicegah secara tajam selama abad terakhir.

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## Hambatan Hukum dan Politik di Depan

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: Spesialis hukum kesehatan mengatakan perintah tersebut kemungkinan akan menghadapi tantangan pengadilan di beberapa lini, termasuk pertanyaan tentang apakah cabang eksekutif dapat secara sepihak mengarahkan perubahan pada jadwal vaksin yang biasanya ditetapkan melalui Komite Penasihat Praktik Imunisasi (ACIP) CDC setelah peninjauan ilmiah independen, serta persyaratan prosedural di bawah hukum pembuatan aturan federal.

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: Beberapa jaksa agung negara bagian dan asosiasi medis telah memberi sinyal bahwa mereka dapat mengajukan penangguhan untuk memblokir pelaksanaan sementara proses peninjauan berlangsung.

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: Perintah tersebut muncul di tengah pengawasan yang lebih luas terhadap kebijakan vaksin di bawah pemerintahan saat ini, termasuk perubahan personel di lembaga kesehatan federal dan upaya sebelumnya untuk meninjau kembali pedoman imunisasi.

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: Karena setiap perubahan resmi pada jadwal yang direkomendasikan biasanya memerlukan pembuatan aturan lembaga, periode komentar publik, dan peninjauan komite ahli, analis kebijakan kesehatan memperingatkan bahwa penerapan praktisnya — jika mampu bertahan dari tantangan hukum — dapat memakan waktu berbulan-bulan atau lebih lama.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: Para orang tua disarankan bahwa, hingga saat ini, jadwal imunisasi yang direkomendasikan CDC yang ada tetap berlaku, dan keluarga dengan pertanyaan tentang waktu vaksin harus berkonsultasi dengan dokter anak mereka daripada mengubah rencana imunisasi berdasarkan perintah eksekutif saja.

ja.title: 1回ではなく3回の接種：トランプ大統領の小児ワクチン接種スケジュール書き換え命令の舞台裏

segments.src: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal health agencies to overhaul the childhood immunization schedule, calling for pediatric vaccines to be spaced further apart and for the combined measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) shot to be split into three separate doses given on different visits.
segments.tr: ドナルド・トランプ大統領は、連邦保健機関に対し、小児予防接種スケジュールを全面的に見直すよう指示する大統領令に署名しました。この命令は、小児用ワクチンの接種間隔を広げ、混合ワクチンである麻疹・おたふく風邪・風疹（MMR）ワクチンを、異なる来院時に3回に分けて接種することを求めています。

segments.src: The order has reignited a decades-old debate over vaccine safety and autism, drawn swift criticism from major medical organizations, and is widely expected to trigger legal action before it can take effect.
segments.tr: この命令は、ワクチン接種の安全性と自閉症をめぐる数十年来の論争を再燃させ、主要な医療団体から即座に批判を浴びており、発効前に法的措置が取られる可能性が高いと広く予想されています。

segments.src: ## What the Order Directs
segments.tr: ## 大統領令の内容

segments.src: According to summaries of the order, the administration has instructed the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to review the current recommended schedule and develop guidance that would:
segments.tr: 大統領令の要約によると、政権は保健福祉省（HHS）および疾病対策センター（CDC）に対し、現在の推奨スケジュールを見直し、以下の内容を含むガイダンスを作成するよう指示しました：

segments.src: - Increase the interval between certain childhood vaccinations rather than administering several shots in a single visit.
segments.tr: - 複数のワクチンを一度の来院で接種するのではなく、特定の小児ワクチンの接種間隔を広げること。

segments.src: - Break the combined MMR vaccine into three individual doses — measles, mumps, and rubella — given separately over time instead of as one combination shot.
segments.tr: - 混合ワクチンであるMMRワクチンを、1回の混合接種ではなく、麻疹、おたふく風邪、風疹の3つの個別の接種に分け、時間をかけて別々に接種すること。

segments.src: - Direct federal agencies to study and report further on any possible link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.
segments.tr: - ワクチンと自閉症スペクトラム障害との間の可能性のある関連性について、連邦機関にさらなる調査と報告を指示すること。

segments.src: The order does not immediately ban the current combination vaccine outright, but it directs agencies to draft new recommendations and consider regulatory or guidance changes that could reshape how pediatricians and public clinics administer shots nationwide.
segments.tr: この命令は、現在の混合ワクチンを直ちに全面的に禁止するものではありませんが、連邦機関に対し、新しい推奨事項の起草と、全国の小児科医や公衆衛生クリニックでのワクチン接種方法を再編する可能性のある規制やガイダンスの変更を検討するよう指示しています。

segments.src: ## The Autism Claim, and What the Science Actually Shows
segments.tr: ## 自閉症に関する主張と科学的根拠

segments.src: The stated rationale behind the order revisits the long-running claim that vaccines, and the MMR shot in particular, are linked to autism.
segments.tr: この命令の背後にある根拠は、ワクチン、特にMMRワクチンが自閉症と関連しているという長年の主張を再検討するものです。

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: その理論は、1998年に『The Lancet』誌に掲載された1本の研究論文に遡りますが、後に調査によってその研究が捏造されたデータと未公開の経済的利益相反に基づいていたことが判明し、撤回されました。

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: その筆頭著者はその後、医師免許を剥奪されました。

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: それから数年の間に、この主張は繰り返し検証されてきました。

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: 65万人以上の子どもを追跡した広く引用されているデンマークのコホート研究を含む、数百万人の子どもを対象とした大規模な研究では、MMRワクチンと自閉症の間に因果関係は認められていません。

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: CDC、世界保健機関（WHO）、米国小児科学会、およびヨーロッパやアジアの同等の保健当局はすべて、現在の科学的証拠は小児ワクチン接種と自閉症との関連を裏付けていないと述べています。

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: 公衆衛生当局は、近年の自閉症診断の増加は、主に診断基準の拡大、認識の向上、スクリーニングの拡大によるものであり、ワクチンの成分やスケジュールの変更によるものではないと指摘しています。

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## 医療団体からの反発

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: 小児科および公衆衛生の団体は、この命令を迅速に批判しました。

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: 米国小児科学会を含む団体は、MMRのような混合ワクチンの接種を遅らせたり分割したりすることは、完全な予防効果を得るために必要な来院回数を増やし、その結果、特に定期的な医療へのアクセスが困難な低所得家庭において、全体の接種完了率が低下することを示唆する研究結果があると警告してきました。

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: 彼らは、接種の空白期間が生じることで、非常に感染力が強く、幼児にとっては深刻または致命的となる可能性のある麻疹などの疾患の発生リスクが高まると警告しています。

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: ワクチン政策の専門家はまた、連邦レベルで自閉症の問題を正式に再開することは、広範に研究され、証拠によって裏付けられていない主張に不当な正当性を与えることになり、過去1世紀にわたって予防可能な疾患による小児死亡率を劇的に減少させてきたスケジュールに対する国民の信頼を損なう可能性があると懸念を表明しています。

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## 今後の法的および政治的ハードル

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: 医療法の専門家は、この命令がいくつかの面で法廷闘争に直面する可能性が高いと述べています。その中には、独立した科学的レビューを経てCDCの予防接種実施諮問委員会（ACIP）によって通常設定されるワクチン接種スケジュールの変更を、行政府が一方的に指示できるかどうかという問題や、連邦規則制定法に基づく手続き上の要件に関する疑問が含まれます。

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: 複数の州の司法長官や医療協会は、審査プロセスが進む間、実施を阻止するために差し止め命令を求める可能性があることを示唆しています。

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: この命令は、連邦保健機関の人事異動や予防接種ガイドラインを見直そうとするこれまでの取り組みなど、現政権下でのワクチン政策に対するより広範な監視の中で出されました。

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: 推奨スケジュールの正式な変更には通常、機関による規則制定、パブリックコメント期間、専門家委員会の審査が必要となるため、保健政策のアナリストは、法的課題を乗り越えたとしても、実際の導入には数ヶ月以上かかる可能性があると警告しています。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の見通し

segments.src: HHS and the CDC are expected to issue further guidance in the coming weeks outlining how the review will proceed and whether any interim recommendations will be issued to pediatricians.
segments.tr: HHSとCDCは今後数週間以内に、審査がどのように進められるか、また小児科医に対して暫定的な推奨事項が出されるかどうかについてのさらなるガイダンスを発表する見込みです。

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: 保護者に対しては、現時点ではCDCが推奨する既存の予防接種スケジュールが有効であり、ワクチンのタイミングについて疑問がある場合は、大統領令のみに基づいて予防接種計画を変更するのではなく、かかりつけの小児科医に相談するよう助言されています。

segments.src: This is a developing story and will be updated as federal agencies release further details.
segments.tr: これは進行中のニュースであり、連邦機関が詳細を発表次第、更新されます。

de.title: Drei Spritzen statt einer: Einblick in Trumps Anordnung zur Überarbeitung des Impfplans für Kinder

segments.src: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal health agencies to overhaul the childhood immunization schedule, calling for pediatric vaccines to be spaced further apart and for the combined measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) shot to be split into three separate doses given on different visits.
segments.tr: Präsident Donald Trump hat eine Durchführungsverordnung unterzeichnet, die Bundesgesundheitsbehörden anweist, den Impfplan für Kinder grundlegend zu überarbeiten. Er fordert, dass Impfungen im Kindesalter in größeren zeitlichen Abständen verabreicht werden und die kombinierte Masern-Mumps-Röteln-Impfung (MMR) in drei separate Dosen aufgeteilt wird, die bei unterschiedlichen Arztbesuchen verabreicht werden sollen.

segments.src: The order has reignited a decades-old debate over vaccine safety and autism, drawn swift criticism from major medical organizations, and is widely expected to trigger legal action before it can take effect.
segments.tr: Die Anordnung hat eine jahrzehntealte Debatte über Impfstoffsicherheit und Autismus neu entfacht, stieß auf rasche Kritik von großen medizinischen Organisationen und wird voraussichtlich rechtliche Schritte nach sich ziehen, bevor sie in Kraft treten kann.

segments.src: ## What the Order Directs
segments.tr: ## Was die Anordnung vorschreibt

segments.src: According to summaries of the order, the administration has instructed the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to review the current recommended schedule and develop guidance that would:
segments.tr: Zusammenfassungen der Anordnung zufolge hat die Regierung das Ministerium für Gesundheit und soziale Dienste (HHS) und die Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) angewiesen, den aktuellen empfohlenen Impfplan zu überprüfen und Richtlinien zu entwickeln, die Folgendes vorsehen:

segments.src: - Increase the interval between certain childhood vaccinations rather than administering several shots in a single visit.
segments.tr: - Vergrößerung des Intervalls zwischen bestimmten Impfungen im Kindesalter, anstatt mehrere Spritzen bei einem einzigen Besuch zu verabreichen.

segments.src: - Break the combined MMR vaccine into three individual doses — measles, mumps, and rubella — given separately over time instead of as one combination shot.
segments.tr: - Aufteilung des kombinierten MMR-Impfstoffs in drei Einzeldosen – Masern, Mumps und Röteln –, die im Laufe der Zeit separat verabreicht werden, anstatt als eine Kombinationsimpfung.

segments.src: - Direct federal agencies to study and report further on any possible link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.
segments.tr: - Anweisung an Bundesbehörden, einen möglichen Zusammenhang zwischen Impfstoffen und Autismus-Spektrum-Störungen weiter zu untersuchen und darüber zu berichten.

segments.src: The order does not immediately ban the current combination vaccine outright, but it directs agencies to draft new recommendations and consider regulatory or guidance changes that could reshape how pediatricians and public clinics administer shots nationwide.
segments.tr: Die Anordnung verbietet den aktuellen Kombinationsimpfstoff nicht sofort gänzlich, weist die Behörden jedoch an, neue Empfehlungen auszuarbeiten und regulatorische oder richtlinienbezogene Änderungen in Betracht zu ziehen, die die Art und Weise, wie Kinderärzte und öffentliche Kliniken landesweit Impfungen verabreichen, verändern könnten.

segments.src: ## The Autism Claim, and What the Science Actually Shows
segments.tr: ## Die Autismus-Behauptung und was die Wissenschaft tatsächlich zeigt

segments.src: The stated rationale behind the order revisits the long-running claim that vaccines, and the MMR shot in particular, are linked to autism.
segments.tr: Die erklärte Begründung für die Anordnung greift die seit langem bestehende Behauptung auf, dass Impfstoffe, und insbesondere die MMR-Impfung, mit Autismus in Verbindung stehen.

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: Diese Theorie geht auf eine einzige Studie aus dem Jahr 1998 zurück, die in *The Lancet* veröffentlicht wurde. Sie wurde später zurückgezogen, nachdem Ermittler festgestellt hatten, dass die Forschung auf gefälschten Daten und nicht offengelegten finanziellen Interessenkonflikten beruhte.

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: Dem Hauptautor wurde in der Folge die ärztliche Zulassung entzogen.

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: In den Jahren seither wurde diese Behauptung wiederholt untersucht.

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: Groß angelegte Studien mit Millionen von Kindern – darunter eine viel zitierte dänische Kohortenstudie, die mehr als 650.000 Kinder begleitete – haben keinen kausalen Zusammenhang zwischen dem MMR-Impfstoff und Autismus festgestellt.

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: Die CDC, die Weltgesundheitsorganisation, die American Academy of Pediatrics und vergleichbare Gesundheitsbehörden in Europa und Asien erklären alle, dass die vorliegenden Erkenntnisse keinen Zusammenhang zwischen Impfungen im Kindesalter und Autismus stützen.

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: Vertreter des öffentlichen Gesundheitswesens weisen darauf hin, dass die Zahl der Autismus-Diagnosen in den letzten Jahrzehnten vor allem auf breitere Diagnosekriterien, ein geschärftes Bewusstsein und ein ausgeweitetes Screening zurückzuführen ist – und nicht auf eine Veränderung der Inhaltsstoffe von Impfstoffen oder der Impfpläne.

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## Gegenwind von medizinischen Fachverbänden

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: Pädiatrische und gesundheitspolitische Organisationen reagierten schnell mit Kritik an der Anordnung.

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: Gruppen wie die American Academy of Pediatrics warnen seit langem, dass eine Verzögerung oder Aufteilung von Kombinationsimpfstoffen wie MMR die Anzahl der erforderlichen Klinikbesuche erhöht, um einen vollständigen Schutz zu erreichen. Untersuchungen legen nahe, dass dies die Gesamtrate der vollständig geimpften Kinder senkt – insbesondere in einkommensschwächeren Familien mit schlechterem Zugang zur regulären Gesundheitsversorgung.

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: Eine Lücke im Impfschutz, so warnen sie, erhöht das Risiko von Ausbrüchen von Krankheiten wie Masern, die hochgradig ansteckend sind und bei Kleinkindern schwerwiegend oder tödlich verlaufen können.

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: Experten für Impfpolitik haben zudem die Sorge geäußert, dass die formelle Wiederaufnahme der Autismus-Frage auf Bundesebene einer Behauptung unberechtigte Legitimität verleiht, die bereits umfassend untersucht wurde und nicht durch Beweise gestützt wird. Dies könnte das Vertrauen der Öffentlichkeit in einen Impfplan untergraben, dem zugeschrieben wird, die Kindersterblichkeit durch vermeidbare Krankheiten im vergangenen Jahrhundert drastisch gesenkt zu haben.

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## Rechtliche und politische Hürden voraus

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: Spezialisten für Gesundheitsrecht erklären, dass die Anordnung wahrscheinlich an mehreren Fronten vor Gericht angefochten wird. Dazu gehören Fragen, ob die Exekutive einseitig Änderungen an Impfplänen anordnen kann, die normalerweise nach einer unabhängigen wissenschaftlichen Prüfung durch das Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) der CDC festgelegt werden, sowie verfahrensrechtliche Anforderungen im Rahmen des Bundesgesetzgebungsverfahrens.

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: Mehrere Generalstaatsanwälte von Bundesstaaten und medizinische Vereinigungen haben signalisiert, dass sie möglicherweise einstweilige Verfügungen anstreben, um die Umsetzung zu blockieren, während das Überprüfungsverfahren läuft.

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: Die Anordnung erfolgt vor dem Hintergrund einer breiteren Überprüfung der Impfpolitik unter der aktuellen Regierung, einschließlich personeller Veränderungen bei den Bundesgesundheitsbehörden und früherer Bemühungen, Impfrichtlinien zu überarbeiten.

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: Da jede formelle Änderung des empfohlenen Impfplans in der Regel ein behördliches Regelungsverfahren, Phasen für öffentliche Stellungnahmen und die Überprüfung durch Expertenausschüsse erfordert, geben Gesundheitspolitik-Analysten zu bedenken, dass die praktische Umsetzung – sofern sie die rechtlichen Anfechtungen übersteht – Monate oder länger dauern könnte.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: HHS and the CDC are expected to issue further guidance in the coming weeks outlining how the review will proceed and whether any interim recommendations will be issued to pediatricians.
segments.tr: Es wird erwartet, dass das HHS und die CDC in den kommenden Wochen weitere Richtlinien herausgeben, in denen dargelegt wird, wie die Überprüfung ablaufen soll und ob vorläufige Empfehlungen an Kinderärzte herausgegeben werden.

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: Eltern wird darauf hingewiesen, dass der bestehende, von der CDC empfohlene Impfplan bis auf Weiteres in Kraft bleibt. Familien mit Fragen zum Zeitpunkt von Impfungen sollten sich an den Kinderarzt ihres Kindes wenden, anstatt Impfpläne allein auf der Grundlage der Durchführungsverordnung zu ändern.

vi.title: Ba mũi tiêm thay vì một: Bên trong sắc lệnh viết lại lịch tiêm chủng cho trẻ em của ông Trump

segments.src: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal health agencies to overhaul the childhood immunization schedule, calling for pediatric vaccines to be spaced further apart and for the combined measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) shot to be split into three separate doses given on different visits.
segments.tr: Tổng thống Donald Trump đã ký một sắc lệnh hành pháp chỉ đạo các cơ quan y tế liên bang đại tu lịch tiêm chủng cho trẻ em, kêu gọi giãn cách các loại vắc-xin nhi khoa hơn nữa và tách mũi vắc-xin kết hợp sởi-quai bị-rubella (MMR) thành ba liều riêng biệt được tiêm vào các lần khám khác nhau.

segments.src: The order has reignited a decades-old debate over vaccine safety and autism, drawn swift criticism from major medical organizations, and is widely expected to trigger legal action before it can take effect.
segments.tr: Sắc lệnh này đã làm bùng発 lại cuộc tranh cãi kéo dài hàng thập kỷ về sự an toàn của vắc-xin và bệnh tự kỷ, vấp phải sự chỉ trích nhanh chóng từ các tổ chức y tế lớn, và được dự đoán rộng rãi sẽ châm ngòi cho hành động pháp lý trước khi nó có hiệu lực.

segments.src: ## What the Order Directs
segments.tr: ## Sắc lệnh chỉ đạo những gì

segments.src: According to summaries of the order, the administration has instructed the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to review the current recommended schedule and develop guidance that would:
segments.tr: Theo các bản tóm tắt về sắc lệnh, chính quyền đã hướng dẫn Bộ Y tế và Dịch vụ Nhân sinh (HHS) cùng Trung tâm Kiểm soát và Phòng ngừa Dịch bệnh (CDC) xem xét lịch trình được khuyến nghị hiện tại và phát triển hướng dẫn nhằm:

segments.src: - Increase the interval between certain childhood vaccinations rather than administering several shots in a single visit.
segments.tr: - Tăng khoảng thời gian giữa một số lần tiêm chủng cho trẻ em thay vì tiêm nhiều mũi trong một lần khám.

segments.src: - Break the combined MMR vaccine into three individual doses — measles, mumps, and rubella — given separately over time instead of as one combination shot.
segments.tr: - Chia vắc-xin MMR kết hợp thành ba liều riêng lẻ — sởi, quai bị và rubella — được tiêm riêng biệt theo thời gian thay vì dùng một mũi kết hợp.

segments.src: - Direct federal agencies to study and report further on any possible link between vaccines and autism spectrum disorder.
segments.tr: - Chỉ đạo các cơ quan liên bang nghiên cứu và báo cáo thêm về bất kỳ mối liên hệ nào có thể có giữa vắc-xin và rối loạn phổ tự kỷ.

segments.src: The order does not immediately ban the current combination vaccine outright, but it directs agencies to draft new recommendations and consider regulatory or guidance changes that could reshape how pediatricians and public clinics administer shots nationwide.
segments.tr: Sắc lệnh không ngay lập tức cấm hoàn toàn vắc-xin kết hợp hiện tại, nhưng nó chỉ đạo các cơ quan soạn thảo các khuyến nghị mới và xem xét các thay đổi về quy định hoặc hướng dẫn có thể định hình lại cách các bác sĩ nhi khoa và phòng khám công cộng tiêm chủng trên toàn quốc.

segments.src: ## The Autism Claim, and What the Science Actually Shows
segments.tr: ## Tuyên bố về bệnh tự kỷ, và khoa học thực sự cho thấy điều gì

segments.src: The stated rationale behind the order revisits the long-running claim that vaccines, and the MMR shot in particular, are linked to autism.
segments.tr: Lý do được nêu đằng sau sắc lệnh này nhìn lại tuyên bố lâu nay cho rằng vắc-xin, đặc biệt là mũi tiêm MMR, có liên quan đến bệnh tự kỷ.

segments.src: That theory traces back to a single 1998 study published in *The Lancet*, which was later retracted after investigators found the research was based on falsified data and undisclosed financial conflicts of interest.
segments.tr: Lý thuyết đó bắt nguồn từ một nghiên cứu duy nhất năm 1998 được công bố trên *The Lancet*, sau đó đã bị rút lại sau khi các nhà điều tra phát hiện ra rằng nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu bị làm giả và xung đột lợi ích tài chính không được tiết lộ.

segments.src: Its lead author subsequently lost his medical license.
segments.tr: Tác giả chính của nó sau đó đã bị tước giấy phép hành nghề y.

segments.src: In the years since, the claim has been examined repeatedly.
segments.tr: Trong những năm kể từ đó, tuyên bố này đã được kiểm tra nhiều lần.

segments.src: Large-scale studies involving millions of children — including a widely cited Danish cohort study following more than 650,000 children — have found no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism.
segments.tr: Các nghiên cứu quy mô lớn liên quan đến hàng triệu trẻ em — bao gồm một nghiên cứu đoàn hệ nổi tiếng của Đan Mạch theo dõi hơn 650.000 trẻ em — đã không tìm thấy mối liên hệ nhân quả nào giữa vắc-xin MMR và bệnh tự kỷ.

segments.src: The CDC, the World Health Organization, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and equivalent health authorities in Europe and Asia all state that current evidence does not support a connection between childhood vaccination and autism.
segments.tr: CDC, Tổ chức Y tế Thế giới, Viện Hàn lâm Nhi khoa Hoa Kỳ và các cơ quan y tế tương đương ở Châu Âu và Châu Á đều tuyên bố rằng bằng chứng hiện tại không hỗ trợ mối liên hệ giữa việc tiêm chủng cho trẻ em và bệnh tự kỷ.

segments.src: Public health officials note that autism diagnoses have risen over recent decades largely due to broader diagnostic criteria, increased awareness, and expanded screening — not a change in vaccine ingredients or schedules.
segments.tr: Các quan chức y tế công cộng lưu ý rằng chẩn đoán tự kỷ đã tăng lên trong những thập kỷ gần đây chủ yếu là do tiêu chuẩn chẩn đoán rộng hơn, nhận thức tăng lên và việc sàng lọc được mở rộng — chứ không phải do thay đổi thành phần hoặc lịch trình vắc-xin.

segments.src: ## Pushback From Medical Groups
segments.tr: ## Sự phản đối từ các nhóm y tế

segments.src: Pediatric and public health organizations moved quickly to criticize the order.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức y tế công cộng và nhi khoa đã hành động nhanh chóng để chỉ trích sắc lệnh này.

segments.src: Groups including the American Academy of Pediatrics have historically warned that delaying or splitting combination vaccines like MMR increases the number of clinic visits required to achieve full protection, which research suggests lowers overall completion rates — particularly among lower-income families with less access to regular healthcare.
segments.tr: Các nhóm bao gồm Viện Hàn lâm Nhi khoa Hoa Kỳ từ lâu đã cảnh báo rằng việc trì hoãn hoặc tách các loại vắc-xin kết hợp như MMR làm tăng số lượng các chuyến thăm phòng khám cần thiết để đạt được khả năng bảo vệ hoàn toàn, mà nghiên cứu cho thấy làm giảm tỷ lệ hoàn thành tổng thể — đặc biệt là trong số các gia đình có thu nhập thấp ít tiếp cận với chăm sóc sức khỏe thường xuyên.

segments.src: A gap in coverage, they warn, raises the risk of outbreaks of diseases such as measles, which is highly contagious and can be serious or fatal in young children.
segments.tr: Họ cảnh báo rằng khoảng trống trong phạm vi bảo hiểm làm tăng nguy cơ bùng phát các bệnh như sởi, vốn có khả năng lây nhiễm cao và có thể nghiêm trọng hoặc gây tử vong ở trẻ nhỏ.

segments.src: Vaccine policy experts have also raised concerns that formally reopening the autism question at the federal level lends undue legitimacy to a claim that has been extensively studied and not supported by evidence, potentially undermining public trust in a schedule credited with sharply reducing childhood mortality from preventable diseases over the past century.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia chính sách vắc-xin cũng bày tỏ lo ngại rằng việc chính thức mở lại vấn đề tự kỷ ở cấp liên bang mang lại tính hợp pháp không đáng có cho một tuyên bố đã được nghiên cứu kỹ lưỡng và không được bằng chứng hỗ trợ, có khả năng làm suy yếu lòng tin của công chúng vào một lịch trình được ghi nhận là đã làm giảm mạnh tỷ lệ tử vong ở trẻ em do các bệnh có thể phòng ngừa được trong thế kỷ qua.

segments.src: ## Legal and Political Hurdles Ahead
segments.tr: ## Các rào cản pháp lý và chính trị phía trước

segments.src: Health law specialists say the order is likely to face court challenges on several fronts, including questions over whether the executive branch can unilaterally direct changes to vaccine schedules that are typically set through the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) following independent scientific review, as well as procedural requirements under federal rulemaking law.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia luật y tế cho biết sắc lệnh này có khả năng phải đối mặt với các thách thức pháp lý trên nhiều mặt, bao gồm các câu hỏi về việc liệu nhánh hành pháp có thể đơn phương chỉ đạo các thay đổi đối với lịch tiêm chủng vốn thường được thiết lập thông qua Ủy ban Cố vấn về Thực hành Tiêm chủng (ACIP) của CDC sau khi đánh giá khoa học độc lập hay không, cũng như các yêu cầu thủ tục theo luật làm luật liên bang.

segments.src: Several state attorneys general and medical associations have signaled they may seek injunctions to block implementation while the review process plays out.
segments.tr: Một số tổng chưởng lý tiểu bang và hiệp hội y tế đã ra hiệu rằng họ có thể tìm kiếm lệnh cấm tạm thời để chặn việc thực hiện trong khi quá trình xem xét diễn ra.

segments.src: The order arrives amid broader scrutiny of vaccine policy under the current administration, including personnel changes at federal health agencies and previous efforts to revisit immunization guidelines.
segments.tr: Sắc lệnh này xuất hiện trong bối cảnh chính sách vắc-xin bị giám sát chặt chẽ hơn dưới thời chính quyền hiện tại, bao gồm các thay đổi nhân sự tại các cơ quan y tế liên bang và những nỗ lực trước đây nhằm xem xét lại các nguyên tắc tiêm chủng.

segments.src: Because any formal change to the recommended schedule typically requires agency rulemaking, public comment periods, and expert committee review, health policy analysts caution that the practical rollout — if it survives legal challenges — could take months or longer.
segments.tr: Vì bất kỳ thay đổi chính thức nào đối với lịch trình được khuyến nghị thường đòi hỏi phải làm quy tắc của cơ quan, thời gian lấy ý kiến công chúng và đánh giá của ủy ban chuyên gia, các nhà phân tích chính sách y tế cảnh báo rằng việc triển khai thực tế — nếu nó tồn tại qua các thách thức pháp lý — có thể mất nhiều tháng hoặc lâu hơn.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: HHS and the CDC are expected to issue further guidance in the coming weeks outlining how the review will proceed and whether any interim recommendations will be issued to pediatricians.
segments.tr: HHS và CDC dự kiến sẽ đưa ra hướng dẫn bổ sung trong những tuần tới phác thảo cách thức quá trình xem xét sẽ tiến hành và liệu có bất kỳ khuyến nghị tạm thời nào sẽ được ban hành cho các bác sĩ nhi khoa hay không.

segments.src: Parents are advised that, as of now, the existing CDC-recommended immunization schedule remains in effect, and families with questions about vaccine timing should consult their child's pediatrician rather than change immunization plans based on the executive order alone.
segments.tr: Cha mẹ được khuyên rằng, tính đến thời điểm hiện tại, lịch tiêm chủng hiện do CDC khuyến nghị vẫn có hiệu lực và các gia đình có thắc mắc về thời điểm tiêm vắc-xin nên tham khảo ý kiến bác sĩ nhi khoa của con mình thay vì thay đổi kế hoạch tiêm chủng chỉ dựa trên sắc lệnh hành pháp.

segments.tr: Đây là một câu chuyện đang phát triển và sẽ được cập nhật khi các cơ quan liên bang công bố thêm chi tiết.
